name: Queens Park
description: One of the city's largest play areas, in a sheltered valley park with a wildlife pond. Toilets, including an accessible one, are next to the café facing the play park. The café opens daily in summer, and only when the weather allows in winter.

nearby.label: On-street parking only, with accessible bays near the park
